in_marathi.name: Devika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi, the goddess of gods, is the source of all creation, preservation, and destruction. The name Devika is derived from the Sanskrit word Devi, meaning 'goddess'. In Hindu mythology, Devi represents the divine feminine energy and is worshipped as the mother goddess.

vedic_reference.note: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word देवी (Devī), which means 'Goddess'. In Hindu mythology, Devi is the mother goddess and is often considered the embodiment of Shakti or divine power. She is revered as the Goddess of Gods and is also known as Lakshmi, the goddess of prosperity and wealth.
